paragraphs.text:
Charlie  drops  her  eyes,  as  she  sometimes  did  when  you 
challenged  her  superstitions.  She  speaks  with  a  breathy 
overtone, something no human throat could produce. “You are 
always so certain of your science, Professor. But I have been with the 
Great Wind-Walker. Look.” She points to her feet.

You  glance  down  and  nearly  drop  your  rifle.  Her  lower 
legs are blackened, corroded stumps with glowing cracks, and 
repulsive hooves instead of feet.
Attempt a Sanity roll: if you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 209.
